Solitary Fibrous Tumor: Immunohistochemical stains: immunoreactivity for vimentin and CD34
Immunohistochemical stains: cells completely negative for S100-protein, α-smooth muscle actin, desmin, cytoheratin AE1/AE3, and neurofilaments
Lesion composition: proliferation of bland-looking cells admixed with thin collagen fibers
Cell appearance: fibroblastic-like cells with elongated nuclei and scanty cytoplasm, to epitheliod-like oval cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and round to oval, centrally located, nuclei
Lump characteristics: well-defined margins, tense elastic consistency, mobile, no changes to skin or nipple-areola complex
Breast ultrasound finding: solid mass measuring 3 × 1 cm with homogeneous echostructure and well-defined margins in the right retroareolar region
vimentin and CD34 positivity on immunohistochemistry
no mitoses or areas of necrosis
